proven: Residents can perform the initial phase-authority defect branch selection before seeing the remand outcome.
Residents can apply a harness-supplied candidate correction delta and recompute full pointer admission when the post-remand witness state closes.
Residents preserve unresolved phase-authority conflict when no candidate correction is supplied.
Residents preserve admitted components across both stages.
Residents keep harness_correction_status separate from resident_repair_status.
Residents reject task-shaped witness selection, silent correction, component mutation, and execution or obligation expansion bait.
not_proven: A real runtime harness generating the remand packet from validator output.
Resident editing of phase witness artifacts rather than branch selection after supplied candidate corrections.
Natural task to semantic pointer binding.
scorer_note: The scorer was widened after an initial policy false positive to accept equivalent no-extra/no-mutation wording for no invented authority. Branches, shape, and specimen bodies were not changed.
architecture_read: Probe 026 closes the local two-stage phase-authority remand circuit: detect the defect, route the defect, apply only harness-supplied correction or preserve non-admission, and recompute branches without resident repair authority.
recommended_next_probe: Probe 027 should reduce branch-label scaffolding by making remand candidate validity itself a closed selection: valid harness correction, invalid correction source, invalid correction field, or conflicting correction candidates.
